# Global Christianity Today Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L13 - Global Christianity Today.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L13 - Global Christianity Today
- Big idea: Christianity is globally diverse, requiring humility about local assumptions and attention to faithful communities beyond Western history.
- Primary reading: Revelation 7:9-12; selected demographic history

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary/local source packet has been verified and cited.
